projects.title: Chaos Lab
projects.description: Built a multi-region chaos engineering lab on AWS using HashiCorp Nomad, Consul, and Terraform. Two federated clusters across us-east-1 and us-west-2 run a demo app behind AWS Global Accelerator and Traefik, all on EC2 spot instances to keep costs near zero. Wrote a custom Go CLI that injects faults (allocation kills, HTTP error injection, latency simulation) and auto-annotates Grafana dashboards so every experiment is self-documenting. Infrastructure is fully automated — a single deploy script bakes AMIs with Packer, provisions with Terraform, and deploys jobs to Nomad. Operator access runs entirely over Tailscale with no public facing ports. Demonstrates fault tolerance, automated recovery, and observability under real failure conditions.

projects.title: Open Source Contribution — Digger (Terraform CI/CD)
projects.description:
Fixed a bug in Digger, an open source Terraform CI/CD orchestration tool (4.9k+ GitHub stars), where terraform init failures were silently swallowed — the error output was never surfaced in the PR run report, leaving users with no visibility into why their pipeline failed.
The fix ensured the root cause of terraform init failures is captured and posted in the Digger run report comment on the pull request, restoring the feedback loop engineers depend on when troubleshooting broken Terraform configurations.
PR was reviewed and merged by the Digger maintainers.
